issue.title: Bug: `bgp/test_prefix_list_suppress.py` fails expecting syslog `AsPath Manager is enabled for`

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

On UT2 we see `bgp/test_prefix_list_suppress.py::TestAnchorPrefixRegression::test_prefix_list_mgr_running_on_every_device` fail occasionally on UT2 systems expecting a syslog that hasn't arrived yet:
```
>               pytest_assert(
                    new_line.strip(),
                    "Expected 'AsPath Manager is enabled for <DEVICE_TYPE>'"
                    " log line on spine device {} after bgpcfgd restart in"
                    " {}".format(duthost.hostname, container),
                )
E               Failed: Expected 'AsPath Manager is enabled for <DEVICE_TYPE>' log line on spine device ctn104 after bgpcfgd restart in bgp

container  = 'bgp'
duthost    = <MultiAsicSonicHost ctn104>
legacy     = ''
marker     = 'SONIC_TEST_MARKER_eace12a77bd4'
new_line   = ''
rand_one_frontend_duthost = <MultiAsicSonicHost ctn104>
self       = <test_prefix_list_suppress.TestAnchorPrefixRegression object at 0x7f607f797bc0>
sonichost  = <SonicHost ctn104>
spine      = True

bgp/test_prefix_list_suppress.py:735: Failed
```

Looking at the syslog we can see that it searched for the syslog here:
```
2026 Sep  9 <IPV6>.971255 ctn104 INFO python3.13[680444]: ansible-ansible.legacy.command Invoked with _raw_params=sudo sed -n '/SONIC_TEST_MARKER_eace12a77bd4/,$p' /var/log/syslog | grep -v 'Invoked with _raw_params' | grep -E 'AsPath Manager is enabled for' || true _uses_shell=True expand_argument_vars=True stdin_add_newline=True strip_empty_ends=True cmd=None argv=None chdir=None executable=None creates=None removes=None stdin=None
```

And the syslog showed up ~1s later:
```
2026 Sep  9 <IPV6>.160259 ctn104 NOTICE bgp#bgpcfgd: AsPath Manager is enabled for UpperSpineRouter
```

Here is the full syslog of relevant logs:
```
2026 Sep  9 <IPV6>.488914 ctn104 NOTICE SONIC_TEST: SONIC_TEST_MARKER_eace12a77bd4

2026 Sep  9 <IPV6>.257317 ctn104 INFO python3.13[680286]: ansible-ansible.legacy.command Invoked with _raw_params=sudo docker exec bgp supervisorctl restart bgpcfgd _uses_shell=True expand_argument_vars=True stdin_add_newline=True strip_empty_ends=True cmd=None argv=None chdir=None executable=None creates=None removes=None stdin=None

2026 Sep  9 <IPV6>.968968 ctn104 INFO python3.13[680392]: ansible-ansible.legacy.command Invoked with _raw_params=docker exec bgp supervisorctl status bgpcfgd _uses_shell=False expand_argument_vars=True stdin_add_newline=True strip_empty_ends=True cmd=None argv=None chdir=None executable=None creates=None removes=None stdin=None

2026 Sep  9 <IPV6>.458479 ctn104 INFO python3.13[680430]: ansible-ansible.legacy.command Invoked with _raw_params=sudo sed -n '/SONIC_TEST_MARKER_eace12a77bd4/,$p' /var/log/syslog | grep -v 'Invoked with _raw_params' | grep -E 'Prefix List Manager and AsPath Manager are enabled for UpperSpineRouter/UpstreamLC' || true _uses_shell=True expand_argument_vars=True stdin_add_newline=True strip_empty_ends=True cmd=None argv=None chdir=None executable=None creates=None removes=None stdin=None

2026 Sep  9 <IPV6>.971255 ctn104 INFO python3.13[680444]: ansible-ansible.legacy.command Invoked with _raw_params=sudo sed -n '/SONIC_TEST_MARKER_eace12a77bd4/,$p' /var/log/syslog | grep -v 'Invoked with _raw_params' | grep -E 'AsPath Manager is enabled for' || true _uses_shell=True expand_argument_vars=True stdin_add_newline=True strip_empty_ends=True cmd=None argv=None chdir=None executable=None creates=None removes=None stdin=None

2026 Sep  9 <IPV6>.160259 ctn104 NOTICE bgp#bgpcfgd: AsPath Manager is enabled for UpperSpineRouter
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `bgp/test_prefix_list_suppress.py::TestAnchorPrefixRegression::test_prefix_list_mgr_running_on_every_device` on a UT2 device repeatedly, eventually it will hit this error

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The only interlock the test checks is that the bgpcfgd service is running in the bgp container before checking the syslog. It's not guaranteed that the process has reached the stage where it emits this syslog nor is it guaranteed that the write has flushed to the syslog file.

We should instead use a `wait_until` to give the bgp process some time for the syslog to show up.

resolution.title: `bgp/test_prefix_list_suppress.py` add `wait_until` for syslog
resolution.description:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/27837

### Description of PR
The test `bgp/test_prefix_list_suppress.py::TestAnchorPrefixRegression::test_prefix_list_mgr_running_on_every_device` expects bgpcfgd to emit syslog 'AsPath Manager is enabled for'
But sometimes the assertion is seen before the syslog shows up (see https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/27837)
Add a wait_until to give bgpcfgd a chance to emit the syslog
